base_rate.reasoning: Sweden has won Eurovision 7 times out of 68 contests (1974, 1984, 1991, 1999, 2012, 2015, 2023), giving a base rate of 10.3%. However, for any single future year, we use 1/participating_countries. With ~37 typical participants, base rate ≈ 2.7%. Adjusting for Sweden's strong track record (7 wins, 2nd most after Ireland's 7), a reasonable base rate is 1.47% (approximately 1.5× the naive equal probability).
